name: fold
description: Draft greenlit Fold listings, go live only on request, and clean up drafted copies after a sale

interface.shortDescription: Draft greenlit Fold listings; go live only when you ask
interface.longDescription: Turns your greenlit Fold listings into private Depop and Vinted drafts — through Depop's own bulk importer or one listing at a time. Drafts are the default; listings go live only when you explicitly ask. When a piece sells, or you choose Delist all, its drafted copies are deleted and its live listings taken down everywhere else, and Fold stays in sync.
defaultPrompt: Draft my ready Fold listings on Depop.
Put my ready Fold listings on Vinted as drafts.
Mark a Fold listing as sold.
